
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(labelled)
library(questionr)

F4_F2 <- readr::read_csv("data_hors_git/process_data/thoa_F4_F2_pour_long.csv", show_col_types = F)
```

# Pivot longer
```{r}

vars_num <- F4_F2 %>% 
  select(starts_with("fa_frt")) %>%
  select(-where(is.character)) %>% 
  colnames()

F4_F3 <- F4_F2 %>% 
  mutate(
    across(
      .cols = all_of(vars_num),
      .fns = ~ if_else(.x == -7, NA_integer_, .x)
    )
  )

vars_to_pivot <- F4_F3 %>% 
  select(starts_with("fa_frt")) %>% 
  colnames()

fratrie0_long <- F4_F3 %>%  
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(vars_to_pivot),
    names_to = c("rang_frt", ".value"),
    names_pattern = "fa_frt(.\\d+)_(\\w+)",
    values_drop_na = TRUE
  )


```

# Renommer variables

```{r}

vars_module <- fratrie0_long %>% 
  select(prenom:deces_an) %>% 
  colnames()

fratrie1_long <- fratrie0_long %>% 
  rename_with( ~ paste0("fa_frt_", .x), all_of(vars_module)) %>% 
  rename("fa_fr_rang" = "rang_frt")

rm(list = c("vars_module", "vars_num", "vars_to_pivot"))

```

# Introduire tagged_na

```{r}

source("Muco_2026/Fonctions/rcd_tagged_na_1rep.R")
source("Muco_2026/Fonctions/lbl_levels_na.R")
library(labelled)

vars_1rep <- fratrie1_long %>% 
  select(where(is.double)) %>% 
  select(-fa_fr_date_creation) %>% 
  colnames()

# Les deux fonctions fonctionnent!

fratrie2_long <- fratrie1_long %>%
  rcd_tagged_na_1rep(all_of(vars_1rep)) %>% 
  mutate(across(all_of(vars_1rep), lbl_levels_na))

table(as_factor(fratrie2_long$fa_frt_sexe), useNA = "ifany")

rm(list = c("vars_1rep", "lbl_levels_na", "rcd_tagged_na_1rep"))

```
